read_before_this_preregistration_no_pred.r0_1: stprk3_stg.F90:430 is the CALL dyn_zdf, guarded IF( kstg == 3 ). The barotropic correction is BELOW it: stprk3_stg.F90:440-441 builds zub/zvb from uu_b(Kaa) minus SUM(e3u_0*uu(Kaa))*r1_hu_0, and :444-445 adds zub*umask to every level 1..jpkm1. Its banner at :433 reads 'All stages: correct the barotropic component', so it runs at stages 1 and 2 as well -- where there is no dyn_zdf and no ordering question.
read_before_this_preregistration_no_pred.r0_2: dynzdf.F90:118 selects the arm: IF( ln_dynadv_vec .OR. lk_linssh ) applies the update ON VELOCITY at :121-122 with no key_qco (1+r3u) ratios; the ELSE arm at :124-138 is the thickness-weighted one. GYRE's deck resolves ln_dynadv_vec = T (round19_oracle_v2_external/ocean.output:798, 'Vector form: 2nd order centered scheme  ln_dynadv_vec  =  T', with ln_dynadv_up3 = F at :801), so NEMO takes the :121-122 arm on this card.
read_before_this_preregistration_no_pred.r0_3: dynzdf.F90:148 guards the pair IF( ln_drgimp .AND. ln_dynspg_ts ). Under it, :150-151 subtracts the PROGNOSTIC uu_b(ji,jj,Kaa)/vv_b(ji,jj,Kaa) from every level, and :156-159 adds zDt_2*(rCdU_bot(i+1,j)+rCdU_bot(i,j))*uu_b(Kaa)/e3u(iku,Kaa) at mbku/mbkv only. zDt_2 = rDt*0.5 (dynzdf.F90:97).
read_before_this_preregistration_no_pred.r0_4: dynzdf.F90:296 puts the same drag on the deepest diagonal: zwd(ji,iku) = zwd(ji,iku) - zDt_2*(rCdU_bot(i+1,j)+rCdU_bot(i,j))/e3u(iku,Kaa). So the implicit matrix's deepest diagonal is 1 + c with c the SAME factor the round-31 regression used as its predictor.
read_before_this_preregistration_no_pred.r0_5: legoESM applies the stprk3_stg.F90:440-445 correction at RK3 stage 3 BEFORE the implicit solve (ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py:6300-6301, through _replace_stage_mean whose target is the prognostic uu_b) and re-imposes the same depth mean AFTER it (:7876-7891, nemo_stage_mean_imposition). Between them, ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py:9867-9875 subtracts a depth mean REBUILT from the solve input (zdf_baroclinic_only) rather than the prognostic uu_b, and :9991-9996 adds the dynzdf.F90:156-159 bottom-stress term with that same rebuilt mean.
read_before_this_preregistration_no_pred.r0_6: Composing r0_5: legoESM hands the solve A - mean(A) where NEMO hands it A - uu_b, with A the explicit stage update. Both sides then force the post-solve depth mean to uu_b, so the whole defect is the column constant uu_b - mean(A) inside the solve. That composition is READ OFF THE CODE here and is what item 1 tests.

item1_ordering_fix.claim_under_test: GYRE's kt=1 stage-3 velocity error is owned by applying stprk3_stg.F90:440-445 twice -- once before dyn_zdf and once after -- while dynzdf.F90:150-151 removes a rebuilt depth mean instead of the prognostic uu_b.
item1_ordering_fix.landing_rule: ONE shared WS-RK3 momentum program, no knob, no card-specific branch, no second implementation. Three statements change and they are one change:
statements_changed: ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py stage 3: the pre-solve call to _replace_stage_mean on u3_raw/v3_raw is removed; stage 3 hands the solve the masked explicit update, because stprk3_stg.F90:437-446 runs after stprk3_stg.F90:430, not before it. Stages 1 and 2 are untouched -- NEMO corrects there too and there is no solve in between.

ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py zdf_baroclinic_only: the removed quantity becomes the prognostic uu_b/vv_b the state carries, matching dynzdf.F90:150-151, and only a state with no barotropic pair at all falls back to the rebuilt depth mean. The same operand then feeds the dynzdf.F90:156-159 bottom-stress term, which NEMO also writes on uu_b(Kaa).

ocean_model_latlon_cgrid.py nemo_stage_mean_imposition: after the solve the stage program applies its OWN correction closure -- target uu_b(Kaa), weights e3u_0/hu_0 -- i.e. stprk3_stg.F90:440,444-445 verbatim, instead of restoring a depth mean captured before the solve with a different weighting rule.
predictions: P1a CONFIRM: kt=1 stage-3 returned u error at model level 30 falls from 9.482370e-07 to below 1.0e-08, and levels 1-29 from 7.131145e-08 to below 7.6e-10 -- the same f = 0.069921016765114 rank-1 ratio, because whatever survives is still mapped by stprk3_stg.F90:440.
P1b REFUTE: level 30 stays above 1.0e-07. Then the ordering is not the owner, or the transcription is wrong, and the fix does not land.
P1c NEITHER: level 30 between 1.0e-08 and 1.0e-07. Report the profile, name no owner, do not claim the fix closed it.

P1d the model's exposed pre-implicit vector IS dynzdf.F90:121-122 (boundary A) after this change, because legoESM's own barotropic removal happens inside the solver, below the exposure point. It scores below 1.0e-08 against the round-29 record's boundary A on u and v. It is 4.269765e-04 / 4.029444e-04 today only because the model's vector is a different quantity there. REFUTE at above 1.0e-06.

P1e NAMED RESIDUAL, not a target: legoESM's stage-3 explicit update carries the key_qco (1+r3u) ratios while NEMO's deck resolves ln_dynadv_vec = T and so takes dynzdf.F90:121-122, which carries none. At kt=1 from rest those ratios differ from 1 by O(ssh/H) ~ 1e-10 on a 4000 m column, so this is expected to sit near 1e-13 x the field and is registered, not fixed, this round.
item1_ordering_fix.instrument: the round-31 walk gate's existing depth_profile and pre_solve modes, run BEFORE and AFTER on the same oracle root, plus the GYRE phase-3 trajectory gate --trajectory-only --max-step 10. No new instrument is built for item 1 (RULE 4: searched scripts/validate/ocean_fidelity/testcases, found both modes already plant-controlled).

No prediction is registered for what the tanks and ORCA2 resolve -- that is measured, and predicting it would be reasoning about a config instead of printing it.

item3_the_0p27_percent.claim_under_test: the 0.27 per cent by which round 31's ordering regression slope sits below 1.0 is the implicit solve's own response to the wrongly ordered column constant, not a second residual.
item3_the_0p27_percent.mechanism_written_before_measuring: the regression predictor is kappa*c with c = zDt_2*(rCdU_bot(i+1,j)+rCdU_bot(i,j))/e3u(iku,Kaa). dynzdf.F90:296 puts that same c on the deepest diagonal, so the matrix returns kappa*c divided by (1+c) plus the vertical-diffusion coupling, never kappa*c itself. The fitted slope through the origin must therefore sit BELOW 1 by O(c), and c's maximum on this card is 2.3943348583166887e-03.
item3_the_0p27_percent.measurement: offline, no model run: from the round-29 record alone, the least-squares slope through the origin of the predictor kappa*c against the model kappa*c/(1+c), i.e. sum((kappa*c)^2/(1+c)) / sum((kappa*c)^2) over the same 580 u and 570 v columns round 31 regressed.
predictions: P3a CONFIRM: the predicted shortfall 1 - slope_model lands within +/-5 per cent of the observed one, i.e. in 2.6029e-03 .. 2.8769e-03 on u. Then the 0.27 per cent is the double application's own image and there is NO second residual.

P3b REFUTE: the predicted shortfall falls outside +/-20 per cent of the observed one, i.e. outside 2.1920e-03 .. 3.2879e-03 on u. Then it is a SECOND residual; the candidate operands to discriminate are the bottom-drag factor's own operands (which velocity, e3u vs e3uw, which level, which time index, under the compiled ppsrc branch for ln_drgimp), the surface-stress boundary condition at dynzdf.F90:329-330, and the thickness used inside the solve.
P3c between 5 and 20 per cent: reported, no verdict either way.

P3d INDEPENDENT ARM, must agree with P3a/P3b: after the fix, a surviving rank-1 residual of about 2.56e-09 (0.27 per cent of 9.482e-07) carrying the same f signature also means SECOND RESIDUAL, whatever the offline arm says. If the two arms disagree, neither is recorded and the disagreement is the finding.
item3_the_0p27_percent.instrument: one new mode, slope_model, added to the existing round-31 walk gate rather than a new script (RULE 4: it already owns read_zdf_matrix, ordering_constant, the stamp and the plant controls). It ships a plant control that must exit non-zero.
